title: Arizona Revised Statutes, Title 23, Chapter 2, Article 7 - Payment of Wages
source_id: A.R.S. tit. 23, ch. 2, art. 7 (within ch. 2, ss 23-201 to 23-495.01)
verified_how: Fetched the Title 23 index. It lists 'Chapter 2: Employment Practices and Working Conditions (Sec. 23-201 to 23-495.01)' containing 'Article 7: Payment of Wages' (and 'Article 8: Minimum Wage and Employee Benefits'). The page states the compilation has been 'updated to include the revised sections from the 57th Legislature, 2nd Regular Session' and reflects law effective 1 January following that session, with the next update after the 58th Legislature convening January 2027.
notes: Article 8 (Minimum Wage and Employee Benefits, the voter-approved Raise the Wage Act) is the companion on rates; only one statute per topic is listed. The register's title index does not print section ranges at article level, so no range is asserted here.
